neighbours.label: the sentence-final full stop of a self-contained statement in impersonal informational prose (notice, bio line, abstract), before a new unconnected statement; the - pole takes the full stop in personal, conversational prose
fire: The library is located at 40 Harbour Road. Free parking is available at the rear. The reading room is wheelchair accessible.
Prof. Novak holds a degree in civil engineering from Purdue University. He can be contacted at the address given below.
BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease is common in older adults. We hypothesized that early dietary counselling would slow its progression. METHODS: We enrolled 180 outpatients.
The lecture is free and open to all. Seating is limited. Tickets can be collected at the box office.
The clinic is open on weekdays. Appointments are required. Interpreters are available on request.
A 4-h half-life and a prolonged 12-h half-life were simulated for the compound. The values for the peak concentration are given in Table 2.
The author is a senior analyst at a shipping consultancy. She has written widely on port logistics. Comments may be sent to the editor.
Total RNA was extracted from frozen tissue. Differential expression analysis was then performed. Results were validated by PCR.
quiet: We finally found the library after an hour of walking in circles. My feet were killing me. I just wanted to sit down.
My uncle studied engineering but never really liked it. He always told us he should have been a chef. I think he meant it.
When my grandmother got sick, none of us knew what to do. We just sat with her and talked. It was all we could do.
I went to the lecture mostly because my sister begged me to. I was bored for the first ten minutes. Then something clicked.
You know that feeling when the waiting room is full and nobody talks. I hate it. It makes me want to leave.
The whole thing took way longer than we expected. Honestly, I stopped counting the hours. We were just glad when it ended.
She told me she writes about ships for a living. I laughed at first. Now I can't stop asking her about it.
We tried the experiment again in the kitchen. It made a huge mess. My brother thought it was the funniest thing ever.

notes: Card: peaks on '.' and line ends in abstracts, notices and code; the - pole (broad, 1.8% of tokens) peaks on '.' in personal/reflective prose and the output direction suppresses ' And'/' But'. Probes were uneven: one abstract 0.58, another two 0.06-0.07; notice and bio lines 0.16-0.29; personal narrative 0.05-0.06. Expect a marginal result.
